verdict.rationale: Canva's docs mention generating personalized content in bulk from your own data (canva-docs-8), importing third-party data for 'Bulk create' (canva-docs-32), autofilling Brand Templates from data sources (canva-docs-7), and automatically creating resized versions of designs (canva-docs-16). That covers bulk design generation, but the evidence is one-line marketing mentions, and the MCP resize tool is rate-limited to 20 req/min (canva-docs-6), which suggests per-item calls rather than true batch operations. Missing for 10: documented batch API endpoints, bulk edit/move/delete/export across many existing designs or assets, AI/MCP-driven bulk workflows, detailed docs on Bulk create limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
